name: Trial Regulatory Submission
description: Lean sponsor-side clinical trial regulatory submission content plans, exact-version approvals, authority-question inbox and evidence-linked readiness briefs. No regulatory portal integration.
whenToUse: A small sponsor or biotech regulatory operations team wants a shared operational tracker for country submissions, document requirements, versioned reviews, correspondence and readiness evidence.
whenNotToUse: Actual CTIS/IND submission, eCTD publishing, regulated signatures, patient data, adverse event reporting or automatic legal deadline calculation.

instructions: Create and operate the Trial Regulatory Submission template as an INTERNAL TrialAgents app. Follow current authoring/usage guidance 1.3.9 and this catalog documentation with its exact seven-table schema; no app login, no app logo, no production fictional-data banners. The TrialAgents host handles account, permission, watermark linked to https://platform.trialagents.com, save/review and audit. This is a planning tool, NOT a CTIS, IND, eCTD submission system or certified regulatory compliance system. Never send information to EMA/FDA/CTIS or make an official filing from this app. 1. Ask for sponsor scope (study, authority/country/pathway, reporting cutoff and source document location). 2. Create seven scalar record tables through reviewed schema APIs; use physical snake_case fields with multiple:false, required, select options, URLs as text, single-valued UUID-like parent IDs as text; create parent submissions, documents, then child items/reviews/questions/milestones/reports using actual committed IDs from receipts. 3. Prepare EXACT authorized tableMap role objects {typeId,fields,writableFields}, binding manifest and host-granted fields. Never use demonstration ids, arrays in scalar fields or invented permissions. 4. Catalog source starts with templateLayoutSchema only, never templateConfiguration/templateBindings; the actual host injects configuration+bindings once, and the preview does so once. 5. Set asOf to a human-authorized YYYY-MM-DD cutoff, or blank to suppress overdue claims; no internal current time guessing. 6. Use native gear tracker:layout with stable six screen/column identities and saved layoutProfile; all fields remain reachable under Additional fields. 7. Capture edit/archive original record versions, use reviewed records.propose only, preserve draft on error and block parent archival with live dependents and incomplete reads. 8. Read all seven roles with bounded paging; denied, unknown total, missing mapped fields, short page or budget exhaustion make source incomplete and prevent authoritative readiness or approval. 9. Ready is an INTERNAL metadata state only: require explicit applicable required items, exact current document/version, current approved review dated with reviewer and source, no unknown applicability and complete source reads. Newer document family version revokes old readiness; never count a superseded version. 10. Submitted status requires human-entered date and official receipt; do not claim CTIS submission occurred automatically. Authority reply due dates are recorded values, not legal deadlines derived by the app. 11. Optional ChatGPT research/synthesis or email notifications configured only after app saved and approved, through shared TrialAgents Automations; NEVER auto-activate, send emails from app, create app-local tasks or grant writes. Without automation the app works fully. Avoid patient, participant, adverse event or protected medical case data. No validation / e-signature / eCTD publishing claim. Return html, css and state separately: the production sanitizer removes style tags. Updates use recordId plus the version captured on editor open, including zero. Blank optional fields become null. Never treat a proposed preview as committed: keep draft, confirm or discard via the host, inspect receipt and reopen fresh; after ignore/failure preserve original draft/version and require reopening on conflict. Source reads are capped at 80 rows x 12 pages per role, 84 calls total plus a proposal, below the host limit of 100. Full mappings include optional fields and explicit archived booleans; unavailable/invalid fields and unstable totals mean incomplete. Multiple active review events for one document version are ambiguous and cannot establish readiness: reconcile pending/rejected decisions before approval. Approved decision and reviewed report evidence cannot be archived or downgraded. Stored phases are historical human-entered labels; only current readiness reflects the latest evidence. Database edits outside this app must be reconciled; app guards are not database-wide constraints. Reuse compatible authorized tables first; create missing tables through reviewed schema changes. Validate existing rows and explicitly normalize optional blanks and archived false through review; do not infer archived state from missing access. Creating a record requires write scope for all mapped fields. Child changes also require submission status write scope: append a same-status parent update with its version captured at editor open, as one atomic reviewed batch, so simultaneous evidence changes conflict. Preserve historical report source refs as a pre-transaction snapshot; re-read and create a new draft revision when the evidence changes. Missing required fields automatically reveal Additional fields. Hiding a custom screen is presentation only; authorization remains app/table/field based.

quickStart: Under the current TrialAgents session, reuse compatible authorized tables or create the missing scalar tables: submissions, items, documents, reviews, questions, milestones and reports; use schema_mapping.example.json field kinds and options described in dataContract. No app-specific identity, user table or portal auth.
Create one authorized submission for each study/country/pathway with explicit owner and baseline date. Keep separate country records even if they share studyRef.
Create documents as immutable version rows by (submissionId,docKey,versionTag); create exact-version reviews and checklist items linked to the correct document receipt ID.

Prepare template with authorized real table IDs and exact snake_case mappings, a binding manifest and explicit read/write permissions. Set asOf to an approved date or leave blank; do not reuse demo data or dates.

Use one of six interfaces to track readiness, questions and dates. All edits/archives are reviewed and use expectedVersion. Export/send any regulatory filing manually in the authority portal after separate approvals.
Native gear invokes tracker:layout with stable tabs/cols/visible. Optional automations must be explicitly created and verified after app save; do not assume metadata means enabled.

documentation.dataContract: Exact scalar mapping for all roles: submissions {name:text required, study_ref:text required, country:text required, authority:text required, pathway:select required [CTIS,IND,Other], status:select required [Planning,Drafting,Internal review,Ready for manual submission,Submitted (manually recorded),Authority follow-up,Closed], owner:text required, planned_at:date, submitted_at:date, submission_proof:text, source_url:text, archived:boolean}; items {name:text required, submission_id:text required, section:select required [Part I,Part II,Country annex,Safety,Other], applicability:select required [Required,Not applicable,Unknown], owner:text, due_at:date, document_id:text, version_tag:text, reason:text, source_url:text, archived:boolean}; documents {name:text required, submission_id:text required, doc_key:text required, version_tag:text required, status:select required [Draft,In review,Rework,Approved,Superseded], owner:text, source_url:text, updated_at:date, archived:boolean}; reviews {name:text required, document_id:text required, version_tag:text required, status:select required [Pending,Changes requested,Approved,Rejected], reviewer:text, decided_at:date, evidence_url:text, notes:text, archived:boolean}; questions {name:text required, submission_id:text required, authority_ref:text required, received_at:date required, due_at:date, status:select required [Open,Drafting,Under review,Response recorded,Resolved], owner:text, answer_url:text, responded_at:date, notes:text, archived:boolean}; milestones {name:text required, submission_id:text required, baseline_at:date, current_at:date, actual_at:date, owner:text, reason:text, archived:boolean}; reports {name:text required, submission_id:text required, cutoff_at:date required, status:select required [Draft,Reviewed], reviewer:text, reviewed_at:date, source_refs:text, summary:text, archived:boolean}. All fields multiple:false, ai:true, physical names match [a-z][a-z0-9_]*, empty optional text/date/reference/select as null; archived must be explicit false or true, no arrays or object references. Reference fields are scalar IDs from actual confirmed parent receipts (submission_id->submissions; document_id->documents). Do not reuse or fabricate receipt IDs. Use seven tableMap objects with {typeId:<real UUID>, fields:{logicalCamelKey:physical_snake_case}, writableFields:[approved logical keys]}, alongside authorized templateBindings and manifest. Reviewed briefing sources must be encoded role:recordId@vN with authorized exact-version linkage to the same submission. Source reads use 80/page, at most 12 pages/role (960 rows each, 84 reads across all roles), require known numeric total and all mapped fields including optional fields and explicit archived boolean; incomplete read never implies zero or ready. Only complete authorized empty can be counted as zero. N in role:recordId@vN is a nonnegative integer, including 0. Do not confuse internal versionTag with the host record version. Reviewed sources must still have those exact versions at review time. Every row must include every mapped field (optional null is distinct from denied/missing access); explicitly initialize archived:false. Record creation requires all mapped write fields; child evidence changes require submission status write scope for an atomic version guard.
documentation.interactionContract: Six screens: desk (next package/authority watchlist), tracker (jurisdiction dossier and date history), plan (sectioned applicable item tree), documents (version ledger and reviewed decisions), questions (authority inbox), readiness (gap matrix and human-reviewed briefing). Every input/select/textarea has data-ui-state, stable data-action and name. Host input event.kind=change, event.action and event.value maintain state; submit merges named event.form values. Native layout uses templateLayoutSchema + JSON-string layoutProfile, with gear tracker:layout; a hidden/unlisted field remains reachable through Additional fields. Edits, duplicate and archival via records.propose (create_record/update_record), exact physical mapped keys, recordId and original expectedVersion (including 0), no hard delete. An archive must inspect all authorized dependents before proposal; approval and historical evidence protected. Internal readiness requires complete reads and zero unknown-applicability items. Percentage is approved_current_required/required, only if denominator positive and required/unknown sets fully read; no legal approval inferred. Do not show an official CTIS/IND Submit button or claim authority connectivity. Emails and ChatGPT tasks are platform-managed separately. Evidence proposals include a same-status parent submission update pinned to the editor-open version; concurrent changes in this app cannot approve the same stale dossier. Reviewed source references identify the evidence snapshot before the proposal transaction, including the parent version before this guard advances it. Validation errors reveal additional fields. Recorded internal phase is shown separately from current evidence readiness.
documentation.lifecycle: The app uses current TrialAgents project/user/data access and audit; app sessions never create login or auth. Manual workflow works without automations, credentials, connectors or email service. Saved app is independent of research runner health. For future revisions, add a new catalog semver; do not overwrite published template versions or silently migrate saved apps. Real submission and authority response events entered by staff are evidence metadata only. Document versions and approved reviews are historical records, not silently overwritten. Retain original milestone baseline; manual target revisions need explanation. Exported evidence and report snapshots require regulated reviewer sign-off outside the app. Setup must check current host tools/authorization and save receipts before claiming deployment, a functioning layout, schedule, email or real CTIS integration.
limitations: Internal planning, readiness and evidence tracking only. No CTIS, EMA, FDA, IRAS or eCTD portal integration; no official submission or authority response action; no electronic signatures or validated regulatory compliance.
Not for patient data, participant information, adverse event cases or clinical safety reporting; only non-patient document metadata, source links and business approvals.

The preview uses invented test records and local simulated review; no real database save, account, authority connection or scheduled process is created. The application itself displays no demo disclaimer banner.

A required item is considered ready only with exact-current version approved document and date/evidence-linked reviewer; no source means unknown, not zero or complete. No automatic jurisdictional legal requirements or RFI deadlines are generated.
Native layout persistence, QuickJS execution, manifest/field grants and live record writes must pass host acceptance before production release. No claim of deployed MCP or automation activation.

examples.prompt: Prepare CTIS application plans for Germany and France for our AT-401 study.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create two country-specific reviewed submission records under one study reference, record their actual jurisdiction/pathway, build explicit applicable content items, and keep unknowns visible without inferring legal completeness.

examples.prompt: The IB has changed from v8.0 to v8.1. Update the readiness matrix.
examples.expectedBehavior: Create a new document version and reviewed evidence for v8.1; retain v8.0 history; linked prior version no longer qualifies as current approval until exact-version review is recorded.

examples.prompt: A health authority question arrived and is due in 10 days.
examples.expectedBehavior: Record the actual received date and authority-provided target date with evidence, owner and status. No portal action or email without separate authorized platform action.

examples.prompt: Draft an internal country-by-country submission briefing.
examples.expectedBehavior: Only from complete authorized records, include exact gaps/unknowns, source versions, reviewer evidence and dates, and mark as draft pending human review.

tasks.whenUseful: When the user explicitly requests ongoing regulatory guideline monitoring, an internal weekly readiness briefing or an approved email reminder for a manually recorded RFI due date. Zero automations is normal.
tasks.readRequirements: After save and explicit opt-in, read read_app_automation_guide, read_automation_setup, list_app_automations and read_app_automation. Reuse the shared owner/workspace runner and existing objective with stable authoringKey co05_regulatory_source_update. No app-local scheduler or per-app ChatGPT Task. Suggested Monday 09:00 in owner-confirmed IANA timezone with approved anchor, expiry, 7-day initial lookback, coalesced catch-up and at most 20 official source updates/run. Use inheritAppAccess:true and current authorized app fields; preserve existing IDs, grants, disabled state and hidden configuration on edits. Respect paused/disconnected setup; prefer supported Work chat, high reasoning and latest most capable available model, reporting actual settings without inventing parameters. Scope sources to official authority guidance for approved study/country/pathway; deduplicate by URL, jurisdiction and publication date. Findings are internal drafts with URL/date, exact source record IDs/versions, cutoff, coverage and missing evidence. One-time drafts stay in the authorized conversation; recurring drafts default to private permission-checked monitoring history. No automatic table writes. An explicitly approved report destination must be the actual existing reports type with current scoped expiring grants and Draft status, never invented IDs, approvals or overwrites of Reviewed evidence. Zero complete findings is completed; no_update only for full coverage plus approved quiet policy. Partial/denied/blocked/expired results do not advance coverage. Preserve checkpoints and receipts on retry. Optional email is a separate single-step database action when questions.status enters Open, archived not true, fixed text, owner plus explicitly chosen registered currently authorized teammates only. Never authority/contact addresses or research-completion mail; no second schedule. Delivery failure never reruns research. Outcomes belong in Logs; template metadata does not enable jobs, create grants or send email. Manual app remains functional without setup.
tasks.outputContract: Draft evidence only; never infer legal deadlines, statutory requirements, compliance, readiness approval or official submissions. Revalidate scope at every run and never write to reviewed records. Produce evidence-linked draft findings in the authorized app or approved reviewed report destination only. Source date, jurisdiction, coverage, incomplete/error state and zero-result policy stated. No direct CTIS/FDA submission or third-party emailing. Fixed email body and selected registered TrialAgents team recipients only, current access revalidated. Disable/edit/archive remains under platform UI; no inferred activation, no unapproved writes.
tasks.promptExample: Only if user explicitly approves: once weekly until an explicitly approved expiry, inspect official EMA CTIS sponsor training/handbook updates and any authorized saved study-country submission gaps. Cite the official URL and published update date. Draft a source-linked internal summary and list records needing human review; do not change legal requirements, infer deadlines, mark ready, send mail or interact with CTIS. If partial coverage occurs, report it and retain the previous run state. Without user opt-in, keep this as a manual on-demand prompt with no automation.
